audience: Solo creators building a reliable content publishing workflow
instruction: Select up to five distinct practical questions about reliable creator publishing from the supplied sources. Favor a clear audience problem and an original checklist or comparison. Return fewer questions if evidence overlaps or is insufficient; do not infer a trend rank.

sources.title: Postiz public API create posts
sources.excerpt: The create request can schedule a post. Its response contains postId and integration fields. This response confirms creation of a publishing task, not actual public visibility.

sources.title: Postiz public API list posts
sources.excerpt: The list endpoint exposes posts with state, publishDate, and releaseURL. A pipeline must query the outcome and inspect the resulting platform link rather than treating the create response as publication.
